quallaSearch.notes: Started with local published aviation-museum story, Ford Island corpus and all selected/candidate metadata. Public-domain military aerials are chiefly from 1930-1943 and do not show restored operations stair details; unrelated people, hangar and memorial images excluded. Former museum aerial/private exterior/CC photographs are not public-domain controls. Only then fetched the exact original photographer-released CC0 tower/operations exterior.

references.artist: Bernard Spragg. NZ from Christchurch, New Zealand

originalReview.notes: Native 2400x1508 original and enlarged stair crop individually inspected. Exact primary photographer page declares CC0; same creator/account/photo ID and Commons reviewed CC0 transfer are bound. Shows orange/white tower, balconies, low cab, operations building and two-flight switchback stair to upper-storey landing. Photo taken 2013-11-09: not every later restoration detail or hidden facade is verified.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: Private museum photograph excluded; no public-domain grant.
